summary: rec.gov API + rates + site catalog and the FS page read: 26 non-electric sites (16 reservable, 10 FCFS), vault toilets + hand pump, $15, Apr 30-Nov 30, 14-night max, 4-day cutoff; max_rig 56 ft from rec.gov. Lakeview kept; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT. On imagery with the rec.gov site points plotted, the nearest sites to the lake are 22 (45.44245,-88.71425, ~45 m), 24 (45.44250,-88.71388, ~50 m) and 26 (45.44254,-88.71351, ~60 m), with 1, 2, 5, 6, 7 ~65-75 m back; all of that ground is continuous forest canopy to the shore, so no site is lakefront. 22 and 26 are FCFS, 24 reservable - all sold by the night.
PIN: stored 45.4415,-88.7153 sits in the main loop (site 15 at 45.44142,-88.71549) - keep.

LENGTHS: the FS page's per-site back-in lengths (25-45+ ft, 'Some campsites can accommodate campers up to 30 feet') disagree with rec.gov's catalog (e.g. site 25: FS 25 ft, rec.gov 56 ft; site 14: FS 25, rec.gov 44). rec.gov trusted (AWH rule); either way plenty of sites take a 23-ft rig.
